policies.policy_document: Fictional Essential Health Plan, Policy Wording 2026-A

clauses.title: Period of cover
clauses.exact_text: Cover under this policy applies to treatment received between the effective date and the expiry date shown in the schedule, provided the policy is in force on the date of treatment.

clauses.title: Insured members
clauses.exact_text: Only persons named as insured members in the schedule are covered, and only for treatment received while their individual cover is in force.

clauses.title: Outpatient benefit
clauses.exact_text: We will pay for outpatient consultations and treatment prescribed by a registered medical practitioner, subject to the limits and cost-sharing shown in Section 5.

clauses.title: Medical necessity
clauses.exact_text: Treatment is covered only when it is medically necessary for the diagnosis documented by the treating practitioner.

clauses.title: Waiting period
clauses.exact_text: Outpatient benefits are payable only for treatment received after 30 days of continuous cover from the member's cover start date, except for treatment following an accident.

clauses.title: Annual outpatient limit
clauses.exact_text: The maximum we will pay for all outpatient benefits per member in a policy year is USD 1,000.00.

clauses.title: Deductible
clauses.exact_text: No deductible applies to outpatient benefits under this plan.

clauses.title: Outpatient copay
clauses.exact_text: The member pays a fixed copay of USD 20.00 for each outpatient visit. No coinsurance applies to outpatient benefits.

clauses.title: Cosmetic treatment exclusion
clauses.exact_text: We will not pay for cosmetic or aesthetic treatment performed to change appearance where there is no documented medical indication.

policies.policy_document: Fictional Standard Health Plan, Policy Wording 2026-B

clauses.title: Period of cover
clauses.exact_text: Cover under this policy applies to treatment received between the effective date and the expiry date shown in the schedule, provided the policy is in force on the date of treatment.

clauses.title: Insured members
clauses.exact_text: Only persons named as insured members in the schedule are covered, and only for treatment received while their individual cover is in force.

clauses.title: Outpatient benefit
clauses.exact_text: We will pay for outpatient consultations, day procedures and treatment prescribed by a registered medical practitioner, subject to Sections 5 and 6.

clauses.title: Medical necessity
clauses.exact_text: Treatment is covered only when it is medically necessary for the diagnosis documented by the treating practitioner.

clauses.title: Waiting period
clauses.exact_text: Outpatient benefits are payable only for treatment received after 30 days of continuous cover from the member's cover start date, except for treatment following an accident.

clauses.title: Annual outpatient limit
clauses.exact_text: The maximum we will pay for all outpatient benefits per member in a policy year is USD 1,500.00.

clauses.exact_text: No deductible or coinsurance applies to outpatient benefits. The member pays a fixed copay of USD 20.00 for each outpatient visit.

clauses.title: Cosmetic and aesthetic procedures exclusion
clauses.exact_text: We will not pay for any cosmetic or aesthetic procedure, including rhinoplasty, performed to change appearance where there is no medical indication documented by the treating practitioner. This exclusion does not apply to reconstructive surgery required because of an accident or a documented functional impairment.
